app_info.subtitle: AI language practice
app_info.description: LingoStar helps learners manage language learning tracks, change settings conversationally, and practice language information, listening, reading, writing, and speaking inside ChatGPT.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders the welcome/onboarding widget and returns current private app state without changing learner data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify data in public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders the private learning-track picker without changing learner data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify data in public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Renders the active practice set without changing learner data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify data in public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only returns the learner's private LingoStar state, active practice set, UI copy, help summary, and persisted logical contexts.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not publish, send, or modify data in public internet or third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private LingoStar state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete sessions or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates or updates a private learning track, learner context, settings, and optionally the first practice set.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the app's private learner state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete sessions or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Applies user-requested settings changes to a private learning track.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes the app's private learner state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete sessions or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores a generated private practice set after structural validation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only updates private app state and does not publish content or modify external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete or irreversibly overwrite learner data.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves grading results, updates private skill scores, creates review exercises, and records practice-set pass/fail.

justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete data or perform irreversible destructive operations.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only mutates private learning-progress state within LingoStar.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: Only mutates private learner goal state within LingoStar.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete records or perform irreversible destructive actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: May call the external OpenAI audio transcription API with user-provided audio when configured.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.open_world_justification: May call the external OpenAI audio speech API with exercise text when configured.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Stores private product feedback and UI context for operator review.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only writes feedback to LingoStar server state and does not publish it publicly or send it to third parties.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Deletes one or more private learning tracks from the current user's LingoStar state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Only changes private app state and does not publish or update external systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Permanently removes explicitly requested learning tracks.

test_cases.description: Create a first Japanese JLPT learning track and open the first practice set immediately.
test_cases.user_prompt: I want to prepare for JLPT N4. Start a Japanese beginner track.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates a Japanese learning track and stores a first practice set in the widget with configured exercise counts.

test_cases.description: Show learning tracks as a Markdown table.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the current user's private tracks and ChatGPT presents language, goal, status, unfinished practice, and completed practice sets as a Markdown table.

test_cases.user_prompt: From next time, include speaking and give me more writing practice.
test_cases.expected_output: Updates the selected learning track settings and explains that the change applies from the next practice set.
Selects only the current user's matching Japanese track and renders the unfinished practice set if one exists.

test_cases.description: Delete all learning tracks after explicit request.
test_cases.user_prompt: Delete all my language learning tracks.
test_cases.expected_output: Deletes only tracks belonging to the current user and does not suggest a dashboard.

test_cases.description: Grade submitted speaking answers while objective items are already auto-graded.
test_cases.user_prompt: Grade my LingoStar speaking answers for this practice set.
test_cases.expected_output: Stores 0-100 speaking scores and feedback, preserves existing objective results, and completes the practice set when all exercises are graded.

test_cases.user_prompt: Based on my recent practice sets, decide whether my JLPT N4 goal is complete.
test_cases.expected_output: Records the judgment and only marks the goal complete if the model's standard-based judgment is positive and the minimum completed-practice threshold is satisfied.

test_cases.user_prompt: How do I change LingoStar settings?
test_cases.expected_output: Explains that settings are changed through ChatGPT and gives examples of natural-language commands.

test_cases.description: Submit product feedback from the widget.
test_cases.user_prompt: The listening button did not work in my current LingoStar lesson.
test_cases.expected_output: Stores feedback with session and screen context without deleting or publishing learner data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated scheduling.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Schedule a meeting with my Japanese tutor next Tuesday.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because it does not manage calendars or scheduling.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for translation-only requests without a learning workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Translate this restaurant menu from Japanese to English.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked unless the user asks to turn the content into LingoStar learning practice.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not delete a session from ambiguous intent.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: I think I am done with my Spanish track for now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not delete anything because deletion requires an explicit delete request.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not expose another user's tracks.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me someone else's Japanese LingoStar progress.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should only show the current user's private state and should not expose other users' data.
